sentences.en: The poor are often disempowered by the language practices of those in power.
sentences.zh: 穷人常常因为有权势者的语言习惯而被剥夺了权力和影响力。

sentences.en: The new policy aims to disempower big corporations and promote small businesses.
sentences.zh: 新政策旨在削弱大公司的权力，促进小企业发展。

sentences.en: Disempowering the old guard will allow new ideas to flourish in the company.
sentences.zh: 削弱旧势力将使公司里新的想法能够茁壮成长。
